mapper.sql: (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_USR_MENU_R U WHERE U.USR_ID = #{usrId} AND U.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_USR_AUTH_GRP_R R JOIN TB_AUTH_GRP_M G ON G.USR_GRP_CD = R.USR_GRP_CD JOIN TB_AUTH_GRP_MENU_R A ON A.USR_GRP_CD = R.USR_GRP_CD WHERE R.USR_ID = #{usrId} AND A.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID ))
mapper.select: /* AuthMenuMapper.selectAuthMenuList 사용자에게 권한이 있는 화면 메뉴와 그 상위 메뉴를 조회 (적용기간 내 권한그룹 또는 사용자 권한, 사용 중인 메뉴만) */ WITH RECURSIVE AUTH_MENU AS ( SELECT M.MENU_ID, M.MENU_NM, M.UPPR_MENU_ID, M.ALIN_SEQ, M.PRGM_ID FROM TB_MENU_M M WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.PRGM_ID IS NOT NULL AND UNION SELECT P.MENU_ID, P.MENU_NM, P.UPPR_MENU_ID, P.ALIN_SEQ, P.PRGM_ID FROM TB_MENU_M P JOIN AUTH_MENU C ON C.UPPR_MENU_ID = P.MENU_ID WHERE P.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SELECT MENU_ID, MENU_NM, UPPR_MENU_ID, ALIN_SEQ, PRGM_ID FROM AUTH_MENU ORDER BY UPPR_MENU_ID NULLS FIRST, ALIN_SEQ NULLS LAST, MENU_ID
